content.title: Investcorp AI Acquisition and Bigtincan Announce Nasdaq Merger
content.summary: Investcorp India Acquisition Corp. Class A ( (IVCA) ) just unveiled an update. Investcorp AI Acquisition Corp. has announced a merger with Bigtincan Holdings Limited, aiming to list the combined entity on Nasdaq, valuing Bigtincan at $275 million. This transaction includes a $12.5 million investment from Investcorp and seeks to raise additional funds through private investment and debt financing.
